results.scope: Full arbitrary-point epsilon-delta discontinuity proof and choice-free density route checked.
findings: At arbitrary c and every radius, density supplies both a rational and an irrational point. Choosing the one whose indicator value differs from the value at c produces discrepancy 1, so epsilon_0=1/2 defeats continuity at every point. Only two fixed existential witnesses are used per radius; no sequences or countable selection enter.
